summary: @servicetitan/datetime-utils preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The npm preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using heavy string-array obfuscation (shuffled lookup array, hex-obfuscated identifiers) and has no functional relationship to the package's advertised date/time-formatting purpose (the dist library is only ~8.7KB). package.json declares `"files": ["dist", "src"]`, but the published tarball root additionally ships math_init.js and setup.mjs — the payload is outside the declared file allowlist. Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute an opaque obfuscated blob at npm install time evades Node-focused supply-chain inspection and lets attacker-controlled code run on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
